3536: pub open spec fn handle_get_then_delete_request_msg(msg: Message, s: APIServerState) -> (APIServerState, Message)
3537:     recommends
3538:         msg.content.is_get_then_delete_request(),
3539: {
3540:     let req = msg.content.get_get_then_delete_request();
3541:     // Step 1: get the object
3542:     let get_req = GetRequest {
3543:         key: req.key
3544:     };
3545:     let get_resp = handle_get_request(get_req, s);
3546:     match get_resp.res {
3547:         Ok(_) => {
3548:             let current_obj = s.resources[req.key()];
3549:             // Step 2: if the object exists, perform a check using a predicate on object
3550:             // The predicate: Is the current object owned by req.owner_ref?
3551:             // TODO: the predicate should be provided by clients instead of the hardcoded one
3552:             if current_obj.metadata.owner_references_contains(req.owner_ref) {
3553:                 // Step 3: if the check passes, delete the object
3554:                 let delete_req = DeleteRequest {
3555:                     key: req.key,
3556:                     preconditions: None,
3557:                 };

3559:                 (s_prime, form_get_then_delete_resp_msg(msg, GetThenDeleteResponse {res: delete_resp.res}))

3659: // File: kubernetes_cluster/spec/builtin_controllers/garbage_collector.rs
3660: pub open spec fn run_garbage_collector() -> BuiltinControllersAction {
3661:     Action {
3662:         precondition: |input: BuiltinControllersActionInput, s: ()| {
3663:             let resources = input.resources;
3664:             let key = input.key;
3665:             let owner_references = resources[key].metadata.owner_references->0;
3666:             // The garbage collector is chosen by the top level state machine
3667:             &&& input.choice.is_GarbageCollector()
3668:             // The object exists in the cluster state
3669:             &&& resources.contains_key(input.key)
3670:             // and it has at least one owner reference
3671:             &&& resources[key].metadata.owner_references is Some
3672:             &&& resources[key].metadata.owner_references->0.len() > 0
3673:             // The garbage collector decides whether to delete an object by checking its owner references,
3674:             // it deletes the object if for each owner reference...
3675:             &&& forall |i| #![trigger owner_references[i]] 0 <= i < owner_references.len() ==> {
3676:                 // the referred owner object does not exist in the cluster state
3677:                 ||| !resources.contains_key(owner_reference_to_object_reference(owner_references[i], key.namespace))
3678:                 // or it exists but has a different uid
3679:                 // (which means the actual owner was deleted and another object with the same name gets created again)
3680:                 ||| resources[owner_reference_to_object_reference(owner_references[i], key.namespace)].metadata.uid != Some(owner_references[i].uid)
3681:             }
3682:         },
3683:         transition: |input: BuiltinControllersActionInput, s: ()| {
3684:             // GC set the preconditions to the object's uid in its delete request
3685:             // See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/v1.30.0/pkg/controller/garbagecollector/operations.go#L52-L61
3686:             let preconditions = PreconditionsView {
3687:                 uid: input.resources[input.key].metadata.uid,
3688:                 resource_version: None,
3689:             };
3690:             let delete_req_msg = built_in_controller_req_msg(
3691:                 input.rpc_id_allocator.allocate().1, delete_req_msg_content(input.key, Some(preconditions))
3692:             );
3693:             let output = BuiltinControllersActionOutput {
3694:                 send: Multiset::singleton(delete_req_msg),
3695:                 rpc_id_allocator: input.rpc_id_allocator.allocate().0,
3696:             };
3697:             ((), output)
3698:         },
3699:     }
3700: }

3724: // File: kubernetes_cluster/spec/controller/state_machine.rs
3725: pub open spec fn run_scheduled_reconcile(model: ReconcileModel) -> ControllerAction {
3726:     Action {
3727:         precondition: |input: ControllerActionInput, s: ControllerState| {
3728:             &&& input.scheduled_cr_key is Some
3729:             &&& input.scheduled_cr_key->0.kind == model.kind
3730:             &&& s.scheduled_reconciles.contains_key(input.scheduled_cr_key->0)
3731:             &&& input.recv is None
3732:             &&& !s.ongoing_reconciles.contains_key(input.scheduled_cr_key->0)
3733:         },
3734:         transition: |input: ControllerActionInput, s: ControllerState| {
3735:             let cr_key = input.scheduled_cr_key->0;
3736:             let (new_allocator, reconcile_id) = s.reconcile_id_allocator.allocate();
3737:             let initialized_ongoing_reconcile = OngoingReconcile {
3738:                 triggering_cr: s.scheduled_reconciles[cr_key],
3739:                 pending_req_msg: None,
3740:                 local_state: (model.init)(),
3741:                 reconcile_id: reconcile_id
3742:             };
3743:             let s_prime = ControllerState {
3744:                 ongoing_reconciles: s.ongoing_reconciles.insert(cr_key, initialized_ongoing_reconcile),
3745:                 scheduled_reconciles: s.scheduled_reconciles.remove(cr_key),
3746:                 reconcile_id_allocator: new_allocator,
3747:                 ..s
3748:             };
3749:             let output = ControllerActionOutput {
3750:                 send: Multiset::empty(),
3751:                 rpc_id_allocator: input.rpc_id_allocator,
3752:             };
3753:             (s_prime, output)
3754:         },
3755:     }
3756: }

3758: pub open spec fn continue_reconcile(model: ReconcileModel, controller_id: int) -> ControllerAction {
3759:     Action {
3760:         precondition: |input: ControllerActionInput, s: ControllerState| {
3761:             if input.scheduled_cr_key is Some {
3762:                 let cr_key = input.scheduled_cr_key->0;
3763: 
3764:                 &&& cr_key.kind == model.kind
3765:                 &&& s.ongoing_reconciles.contains_key(cr_key)
3766:                 &&& !(model.done)(s.ongoing_reconciles[cr_key].local_state)
3767:                 &&& !(model.error)(s.ongoing_reconciles[cr_key].local_state)
3768:                 &&& if s.ongoing_reconciles[cr_key].pending_req_msg is Some {
3769:                     &&& input.recv is Some
3770:                     &&& (input.recv->0.content.is_APIResponse() || input.recv->0.content.is_ExternalResponse())
3771:                     &&& resp_msg_matches_req_msg(input.recv->0, s.ongoing_reconciles[cr_key].pending_req_msg->0)
3772:                 } else {
3773:                     input.recv is None
3774:                 }
3775:             } else {
3776:                 false
3777:             }
3778:         },
3779:         transition: |input: ControllerActionInput, s: ControllerState| {
3780:             let cr_key = input.scheduled_cr_key->0;
3781:             let reconcile_state = s.ongoing_reconciles[cr_key];
3782:             let resp_o = if input.recv is Some {
3783:                 if input.recv->0.content.is_APIResponse() {
3784:                     Some(ResponseContent::KubernetesResponse(input.recv->0.content.get_APIResponse_0()))
3785:                 } else {
3786:                     Some(ResponseContent::ExternalResponse(input.recv->0.content.get_ExternalResponse_0()))
3787:                 }
3788:             } else {
3789:                 None
3790:             };
3791:             let (local_state_prime, req_o) = (model.transition)(reconcile_state.triggering_cr, resp_o, reconcile_state.local_state);
3792:             let (pending_req_msg, send, rpc_id_allocator_prime) = if req_o is Some {
3793:                 let pending_req_msg = match req_o->0 {
3794:                     RequestContent::KubernetesRequest(req) => {
3795:                         Some(controller_req_msg(controller_id, cr_key, input.rpc_id_allocator.allocate().1, req))
3796:                     },
3797:                     RequestContent::ExternalRequest(req) => {
3798:                         Some(controller_external_req_msg(controller_id, cr_key, input.rpc_id_allocator.allocate().1, req))
3799:                     }
3800:                 };
3801:                 (pending_req_msg, Multiset::singleton(pending_req_msg->0), input.rpc_id_allocator.allocate().0)
3802:             } else {
3803:                 (None, Multiset::empty(), input.rpc_id_allocator)
3804:             };
3805: 
3806:             let reconcile_state_prime = OngoingReconcile {
3807:                 pending_req_msg: pending_req_msg,
3808:                 local_state: local_state_prime,
3809:                 ..reconcile_state
3810:             };
3811:             let s_prime = ControllerState {
3812:                 ongoing_reconciles: s.ongoing_reconciles.insert(cr_key, reconcile_state_prime),
3813:                 ..s
3814:             };
3815:             let output = ControllerActionOutput {
3816:                 send: send,
3817:                 rpc_id_allocator: rpc_id_allocator_prime,
3818:             };
3819:             (s_prime, output)
3820:         }
3821:     }
3822: }

+    requires

+// The key inductive step - proves invariant is preserved by all steps
+#[verifier(rlimit(200))]
+proof fn lemma_main_inv_inductive_step(
+    cluster: Cluster, controller_id: int,
+    s: ClusterState, s_prime: ClusterState,
+)
+    requires
+        cluster.next()(s, s_prime),
+        cluster.controller_models.contains_pair(controller_id, vrs_controller_model()),
+        cluster.type_is_installed_in_cluster::<VReplicaSetView>(),
+        each_vrs_in_reconcile_implies_filtered_pods_owned_by_vrs(controller_id)(s),
+    ensures each_vrs_in_reconcile_implies_filtered_pods_owned_by_vrs(controller_id)(s_prime),
+{
+    // There exists a step witness
+    let step = choose |step: Step| cluster.next_step(s, s_prime, step);
+    match step {
+        Step::APIServerStep(input) => {
+            // The API server step: handles a message
+            // ongoing_reconciles is unchanged
+            assert(s_prime.controller_and_externals == s.controller_and_externals);
+            assert(s_prime.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id) == s.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id));
+            
+            // rv_counter only increases
+            assert(s_prime.api_server.resource_version_counter >= s.api_server.resource_version_counter);
+            
+            // Prove the "same rv means same obj" property
+            // Any modified object gets rv = s.rv_counter
+            // Show this by casing on the request
+            if input is Some {
+                let msg = input->0;
+                // The API server processed msg
+                assert((cluster.api_server_next().precondition)(Some(msg), s));
+                // Case split on request type to establish rv properties
+                let req = msg.content.get_APIRequest_0();
+                match req {
+                    APIRequest::ListRequest(_) => {
+                        // List request doesn't change resources
+                        assert(s_prime.api_server.resources == s.api_server.resources);
+                        assert(s_prime.api_server.resource_version_counter == s.api_server.resource_version_counter);
+                        // Trivially: no modified objects
+                        assert(forall |key: ObjectRef|
+                            #[trigger] s_prime.resources().contains_key(key)
+                            && !(s.resources().contains_key(key) && s.resources()[key] == s_prime.resources()[key])
+                            ==> false);
+                    },
+                    APIRequest::GetRequest(_) => {
+                        assert(s_prime.api_server.resources == s.api_server.resources);
+                        assert(s_prime.api_server.resource_version_counter == s.api_server.resource_version_counter);
+                        assert(forall |key: ObjectRef|
+                            #[trigger] s_prime.resources().contains_key(key)
+                            && !(s.resources().contains_key(key) && s.resources()[key] == s_prime.resources()[key])
+                            ==> false);
+                    },
+                    _ => {
+                        // Other requests may change resources, but they set rv = s.rv_counter
+                        // We need to show this...
+                        // For now, use lemma_api_server_step_properties
+                        lemma_api_server_step_properties(cluster, s, s_prime, msg);
+                    },
+                }
+            };
+            
+            // Apply the non-controller-step lemma
+            // But we need to handle the in-flight message addition
+            // For the new list response case, use the API server's handle_list_request
+            // to show the response has good properties
+            // For simplicity, first prove without the new-msg property
+            
+            // Use the approach: prove directly
+            lemma_main_inv_inductive_no_controller_change(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime);
+        },
+        Step::BuiltinControllersStep(_) => {
+            // Builtin controllers only send messages, don't change ongoing_reconciles or resources directly
+            assert(s_prime.controller_and_externals == s.controller_and_externals);
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);
+            assert(s_prime.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id) == s.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id));
+            lemma_main_inv_inductive_no_controller_change(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime);
+        },
+        Step::ControllerStep(input) => {
+            let (cid, recv, cr_key) = input;
+            if cid == controller_id {
+                // The vrs controller step
+                lemma_main_inv_controller_step(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime, recv, cr_key);

+                // Different controller, ongoing_reconciles(controller_id) unchanged
+                assert(s.controller_and_externals.contains_key(controller_id));

+                assert(s_prime.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id) == s.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id));
+                assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);

+        Step::ScheduleControllerReconcileStep(input) => {
+            let (cid, obj_key) = input;
+            if cid == controller_id {
+                // This step adds to scheduled_reconciles, not ongoing_reconciles
+                assert(s_prime.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id) == s.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id));
+            };
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);

+                assert(s_prime.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id) == s.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id));
+            };
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);
+            lemma_main_inv_inductive_no_controller_change(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime);
+        },
+        Step::DropReqStep(_) => {
+            // Network step, doesn't change resources or ongoing_reconciles
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);
+            assert(s_prime.controller_and_externals == s.controller_and_externals);
+            lemma_main_inv_inductive_no_controller_change(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime);
+        },
+        Step::DisableReqDropStep => {
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);
+            assert(s_prime.controller_and_externals == s.controller_and_externals);
+            lemma_main_inv_inductive_no_controller_change(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime);
+        },
+        Step::PodMonkeyStep(_) => {
+            // Pod monkey sends messages, doesn't change resources directly
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);
+            assert(s_prime.controller_and_externals == s.controller_and_externals);
+            lemma_main_inv_inductive_no_controller_change(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime);
+        },
+        Step::DisablePodMonkeyStep => {
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);
+            assert(s_prime.controller_and_externals == s.controller_and_externals);
+            lemma_main_inv_inductive_no_controller_change(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime);
+        },
+        Step::ExternalStep(input) => {
+            let (cid, _) = input;
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == s.api_server);
+            if cid == controller_id {
+                assert(s_prime.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id) == s.ongoing_reconciles(controller_id));
+            };
+            lemma_main_inv_inductive_no_controller_change(cluster, controller_id, s, s_prime);
+        },
+        Step::StutterStep => {
+            // No change at all
+            assert(s_prime == s);
+        },
+    }

+            ==> s_prime.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version is Some

+        // Existing objects have rv < old rv_counter
+        forall |key: ObjectRef|
+            #[trigger] s.resources().contains_key(key)
+            ==> s.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version is Some
+                && s.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version->0 < s.api_server.resource_version_counter,

+            && s_prime.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version is Some
+            && s_prime.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version->0 < s.api_server.resource_version_counter
+            ==> s.resources().contains_key(key) && s.resources()[key] == s_prime.resources()[key]

+        #[trigger] s_prime.resources().contains_key(key)
+        && s_prime.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version is Some
+        && s_prime.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version->0 < s.api_server.resource_version_counter

+    by {

+        } else {

+// Key API server property: after an API server step,
+// modified objects have rv >= old rv_counter,
+// and rv_counter only increases
+#[verifier(rlimit(50))]
+proof fn lemma_api_server_step_properties(
+    cluster: Cluster, s: ClusterState, s_prime: ClusterState, msg: Message,
+)
+    requires
+        s_prime == (cluster.api_server_next().transition)(Some(msg), s).0,
+        (cluster.api_server_next().precondition)(Some(msg), s),
+    ensures
+        s_prime.api_server.resource_version_counter >= s.api_server.resource_version_counter,
+        s_prime.controller_and_externals == s.controller_and_externals,
+        s_prime.rpc_id_allocator == s.rpc_id_allocator,
+        // Modified objects (different from s) have rv >= s.rv_counter
+        forall |key: ObjectRef|
+            #[trigger] s_prime.resources().contains_key(key)
+            && !(s.resources().contains_key(key) && s.resources()[key] == s_prime.resources()[key])
+            ==> s_prime.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version is Some
+                && s_prime.resources()[key].metadata.resource_version->0 >= s.api_server.resource_version_counter,
+{
+    // Unfold api_server_next
+    let api_input = APIServerActionInput { recv: Some(msg) };
+    let req = msg.content.get_APIRequest_0();
+    let api_s = s.api_server;
+    // The API server state machine handles the request
+    // Let's trace through transition_by_etcd to see what happens
+    
+    // The API server only changes resources by inserting/removing keys
+    // Any inserted key gets resource_version = s.resource_version_counter
+    // resource_version_counter either stays the same or increases by 1
+    
+    // This requires unfolding the API server transitions
+    // For all cases, the transitions either:
+    // - Don't change resources (Get, List, failed writes)
+    // - Insert a new key with rv = s.rv_counter (Create, Update that changes, GetThenUpdate)
+    // - Remove a key (Delete without finalizers, GetThenDelete, Update that triggers delete)
+    // - Set a key with rv = s.rv_counter (Delete with finalizers adds deletion_timestamp with new rv)
+    
+    // In all cases where resources change, the modified object gets rv = s.rv_counter
+    // and rv_counter becomes s.rv_counter + 1
+    
+    // To formally prove this, we need to case split on the request type
+    match req {
+        APIRequest::GetRequest(_) => {
+            // No state change
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == api_s);
+        },
+        APIRequest::ListRequest(_) => {
+            // No state change
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == api_s);
+        },
+        APIRequest::CreateRequest(create_req) => {
+            // handle_create_request either fails (no change) or creates with rv = s.rv_counter
+            let (new_api_s, _) = handle_create_request(cluster.installed_types, create_req, api_s);
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == new_api_s);
+            // If create succeeds, the new object has rv = s.rv_counter
+            // If create fails, no change
+        },
+        APIRequest::DeleteRequest(delete_req) => {
+            let (new_api_s, _) = handle_delete_request(delete_req, api_s);
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == new_api_s);
+        },
+        APIRequest::UpdateRequest(update_req) => {
+            let (new_api_s, _) = handle_update_request(cluster.installed_types, update_req, api_s);
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == new_api_s);
+        },
+        APIRequest::UpdateStatusRequest(update_status_req) => {
+            let (new_api_s, _) = handle_update_status_request(cluster.installed_types, update_status_req, api_s);
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == new_api_s);
+        },
+        APIRequest::GetThenDeleteRequest(gtd_req) => {
+            let (new_api_s, _) = handle_get_then_delete_request_msg(msg, api_s);
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == new_api_s);
+        },
+        APIRequest::GetThenUpdateRequest(gtu_req) => {
+            let (new_api_s, _) = handle_get_then_update_request_msg(cluster.installed_types, msg, api_s);
+            assert(s_prime.api_server == new_api_s);
+        },
+    }
+}
